papers.title: Weak-field multi-collector benchmark
papers.hypothesis: Under matched observation and policy-capacity budgets, a bounded shared velocity summary improves fixed-horizon unique team capture yield relative to the identical-shape independent controller.
papers.kill_criterion: Stop or narrow if coupled-noise timestep validation fails, shared-minus-independent yield is non-positive or below the relevance threshold, shuffled/delayed messages explain the effect, or useful power exceeds the bounded seed cap.
papers.open_blocker: SPS-WO-05 establishes diagnostic action-contingent headroom for the step-67 unique-yield endpoint. The repaired SPS-WO-06 numerical implementation is preregistered but not run. SPS-WO-07 remains dependency-blocked, SPS-WO-08 is design-stage only, and all learned MARL work remains downstream. SPS-C03 has no coordination result.

papers.kill_criterion: No second paper may activate without a genuinely separable question and Program Director decision.

primary_question: At alpha=0.06 under the canonical four-collector task and a fixed 67-step window, does a bounded three-number shared velocity summary improve unique team capture yield over the identical-shape independent controller?
exploratory_result: SPS-P02 found no first-interception boundary and exposed passive confounding. After that endpoint was killed, SPS-WO-05-R1 passed the preregistered fixed-horizon yield feasibility gate: oracle minus stationary mean 9.375 unique captures with 8/8 positive diagnostic seeds; oracle minus true-field control mean 7.5. This authorizes numerical and coordination diagnostics only and does not support SPS-C03.

SPS-WO-06-TIMESTEP-CONVERGENCE.purpose: Validate that dt=0.02 is a converged discretization; seeds 3001-3008 permanently ineligible for confirmation
SPS-WO-06-TIMESTEP-CONVERGENCE.gate: absolute mean oracle-minus-stationary difference between dt=0.02 and dt=0.01 strictly below 1 particle, with at most 1/8 seed-level sign changes; dt=0.005 mandatory informational

SPS-POWER-ANALYSIS-COORDINATION.purpose: Ex-ante sensitivity analysis for 80% power at a frozen 2.0-particle minimum relevant effect; it cannot consume diagnostic outcomes

SPS-WO-07-ATTRIBUTION-CONTROLS.purpose: Attribution control runs alongside SPS-C03; seeds 4001-4008 permanently ineligible for confirmation
SPS-WO-07-ATTRIBUTION-CONTROLS.gate: all six preregistered empirical, implementation, and matched-stream components pass; descriptive only

engineering_tests.scope: 89 established simulator and inference tests plus 7 dependency-free experiment-design tests covering dyadic Brownian coupling, fixed physical duration, preregistration/config agreement, supported attribution policy IDs, and ex-ante power constants. PyTorch, Gymnasium, and pytest-dependent MARL tests are not counted because those dependencies are unavailable in this workspace.

fresh_review.strongest_new_threat: The positive oracle diagnostic establishes action headroom but the central shared-versus-independent multi-agent treatment remains unexecuted, so there is still no coordination, communication, or MARL result.

last_engineering_action: Audited and repaired the Claude branch: true coupled timestep refinement, supported attribution IDs, aligned preregistration/power design, deterministic MARL scaffolds, genuine communication-ablation eligibility, and evidence-constrained manuscript/ledger updates.
